Ultra-wide street-level view, slightly elevated at a 25° downward tilt, capturing "The Ethereal Art Installation" in the Lumina Grove region of Aetheria at night. The scene is enveloped in a cool, crisp atmosphere of wonder and unreality, with gentle, unseen currents suggested by the soft pulsing of lights. Dominating the immediate foreground is worn cobblestone pavement featuring puddles that reflect the vibrant neon glow of nearby, unidentifiable structures, hinting at the blended reality of Aetheria.

The midground is occupied by the building, its facade a surreal organic light installation seamlessly integrated with the natural environment. It's not centered but slightly to the left, shot at a slight angle to reveal depth. Signage is minimal and abstract, glowing with internal light. Windows are not traditional but appear as shifting planes of illuminated, colored glass. Decorative elements are sculpted light forms, mimicking bioluminescent flora, textured with fine mesh and emitting soft hums and faint electronic pulses. The building itself appears to grow from the surrounding, subtly illuminated forest, with no harsh lines, reflecting the architectural_tone of "surreal organic light installations within a natural setting."

The background reveals the dense, dark canopy of a mystical forest, with tall, slender tree trunks rising steeply. These trees are bathed in electric hues of green, blue, purple, and yellow, creating a dreamlike ambiance. Scattered in the deeper background are faint red and white glows from string lights or lanterns, and a warm orange lantern hangs from a tree on the far right.

The composition is highly asymmetric, with more of the textured street visible on the left. In the foreground clearing, three large, glowing jellyfish-like sculptures made of a fine mesh material are suspended at different heights. The topmost features a purple-white bell with long, luminous green tentacles. Below it, a smaller one shines with a bright white-green bell and matching green tentacles. The largest rests on the forest floor, its bell glowing with warm yellow-white light, and its many elaborate tentacles display a mesmerizing array of pink, purple, blue, and green. Adjacent to this ground-level sculpture is a triangular, pyramid-like structure with intricate swirling patterns of blue, pink, and white, bathed in a strong magenta light from the front. To the right of the ground-level installation, a solitary figure clad in loose, pale clothing stands, their face partially obscured by eyewear, holding a glowing rod or object and observing the illuminated wonders, their presence adding to the sense of contemplation and public spectacle. The overall color palette is dominated by electric blue and vibrant green, accented by magenta, yellow-white, pink, and purple, with ambient light being a cool electric glow interspersed with warm pockets, all rendered in a Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, Green bias style.

Interior of a vast, cavernous Ethereal Art Installation, wide orientation, organic form, large scale, fully enclosed space. The primary focus is on translucent, glowing mesh sculptures, including a central Patterned Pyramid Sculpture and large Glowing Mesh Jellyfish. Vibrant cyan, magenta, yellow, and green artificial light pulsates from within these forms and is projected across the semi-translucent mesh walls and floor, creating a dreamlike, immersive, and surreal atmosphere. Illuminated natural tree trunks and branches, appearing coated in light, punctuate the space. Navigable elements include a glowing archway at the front wall, a translucent curtain object at the left wall, a holographic display panel object at the right wall, and a passage behind the central sculpture. Furnishing includes crystalline seating pods, pulsing light emitters, holographic flora, and interactive light streams. The mood is one of wonder, awe, contemplation, and surreal tranquility, with a cool, still air and a gentle hum of ambient sound. The composition is asymmetric and visually interesting, emphasizing the interplay of light and form within this contemporary art exhibition. Primary surfaces are semi-translucent fine mesh and patterned, frosted glass/acrylic. Secondary surfaces include the light-coated tree elements. Accent features are shifting holographic projections, pulsing internal lights, and subtle atmospheric mist. Ambient light is an ethereal glow.
[CAMERA:] Off center one-point perspective
[LENS:] 18mm f/4, ultra-wide
